correctness.rationale: The only simple cycles are unions of exactly two arms, so the Alexander-dual facets are complements of those cycles. Dominated-vertex collapses reduce the dual to the (m-3)-skeleton of a simplex, with torsion-free reduced homology of rank m-1. Integral Alexander duality gives the unique group in dimension N-m, and full two-skeleton plus Hurewicz/Whitehead yields the asserted wedge for every m≥3 and all arm lengths≥2. Ten exhaustive finite cross-checks corroborate the construction; no infinite claim depends on enumeration.

value.rationale: A complete integral homotopy classification for all multi-theta series-parallel graphs with no direct pole edge extends beyond the 2023 cactus and complete-bipartite special-family calculations. It isolates two independent natural combinatorial effects: adding an arm increases sphere rank by one, while subdividing an existing arm raises homotopy dimension without changing rank. This sharp all-parameter structural law is motivated by overlapping-cycle topology, rather than by a selected finite example or a recomputation of the known K_{2,m} case.
